name: Sam Firstuser
informationText: Audit Notary stores your name, team and role in the person directory of your organisation so that documents can name who worked on them. Documents carry only a pseudonym; the directory maps it to your entry. Controller: the security office of your organisation. Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(b) and (f) GDPR. You can change your entry at any time in Settings; erasure is done by the catalog administrators. (Information under Art. 13 GDPR.)
